# mad-harness

> A multi-agent development harness: model tiering and dispatch, parallel worker
> worktrees, decorrelated verification lenses, a pluggable task tracker (beads or
> markdown), and the doctrine those agents run on. Project-specific facts live in a single
> harness.yaml in the consuming repository.

GENERATED by harness/checks/check-docs.sh — do not hand-edit.
